name: NotificationCard
description: A single notice about something that happened, such as a reply or a system alert: who it is from or an icon, what it says, when, and the actions to take. Unread notices are tinted and marked with a dot.
whenToUse: In a notification list or feed, one card per event.
For a notice with a clear next step, e.g. "Reply" or "View".

whenNotToUse.text: For a short confirmation after an action.
For a message in an ongoing conversation.
For a warning that stays on the page.

anatomy.name: Avatar or icon
anatomy.description: Who the notice is from, or the system icon.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.description: What happened, in a few words.

values.meaning: New: tinted, with a dot at the start.

behavior.text: Pressing the close button calls onDismiss; remove the card from the list in your handler.
The avatar and dismiss button swap sides in Arabic.

content: Write the title as what happened: "Lana replied to your comment".
Show the time in a short form, e.g. "2 min ago".

guidelines.do: Put the most important action first, as the primary button.
guidelines.why: One clear next step is easier to act on than a row of choices.

guidelines.do: Mark notices as unread until they are seen.
guidelines.why: The mark tells people what is new since their last visit.

guidelines.do: Use the avatar when a person is involved.
guidelines.dont: Use the same generic icon for every notice.
guidelines.why: A face makes a notice from a person easy to recognise.

keyboard.action: Moves through the actions and the close button.

aria.when: Names the card by its title.
On the close button, from dismissLabel.

accessibility.focus: Actions and the close button show their own focus rings.

wcag.how: Avatars are decorative beside a named title; icons are decorative.
Text passes AA on both the read and unread backgrounds.
Unread state is also shown by the dot, not only by tint.

notes: The unread dot is decorative; screen readers hear the title and time.

examples.title: Reply
examples.description: A person’s reply with two actions.

examples.title: System notice
examples.description: An icon instead of an avatar, with a dismiss button.

examples.title: In a list
examples.description: Cards stacked in a feed; the list is a plain list of articles.

related.relation: For a brief confirmation that disappears.

components.name: NotificationCard
components.description:
A single notice about something that happened: who or what it is from, what it says, when,
and the actions to take. Use it in notification lists and feeds.

title.description: The notice in a few words, e.g. "Lana replied to your comment".

description.description: Optional second line with the detail.

time.description: When it happened, e.g. "2 mins ago".

avatar.type: { name: string; src?: string; status?: "online" | "offline"; } | undefined
avatar.description: Who it is from; shows their avatar.

icon.description: An icon instead of an avatar, e.g. for system notices.

iconTone.description: Colour of the icon tile. Default primary.

actions.description: Buttons such as Reply and Dismiss, shown under the text.

onDismiss.description: Shows a close button; called when it is pressed.

dismissLabel.description: Words for the close button. Default "Dismiss notification".

unread.description: Marks the notice as new: tinted and with a dot.

--notification-card-gap.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--notification-card-padding-x.description: Gap between groups inside a section.

--notification-card-unread-bg-color.description: App background behind cards and panels.

--notification-card-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--notification-card-body-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--notification-card-time-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--notification-card-description-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--notification-card-actions-offset.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--notification-card-dismiss-offset.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--notification-card-dot-offset.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--notification-card-dot-color.description: Fill of filled buttons; the accent in light mode, a darker step in dark mode.
